title: tune NCCL streams and overlap scheduling for tensor-parallel collectives
author: Liam O'Connor
description:
Motivation: We observed suboptimal overlap between NCCL collectives and local kernel compute when running tensor-parallel workloads on 8+ GPU nodes. This PR tunes NCCL stream assignment, stream priorities, and the runtime scheduling heuristics used by the TP executor to achieve better comm/compute overlap and reduce tail latency.

Summary of changes: - Add configurable NCCL stream allocation strategy and default tuning for common topologies (NVLink, DGX-style meshes). - Introduce stream priority assignment: comm streams get higher priority relative to kernel streams when beneficial. - Update TP scheduler to prefer launching local kernels on low-priority streams if their compute does not block needed comm progress; schedule small kernels asynchronously to avoid stalling collectives. - KV cache barrier optimization: ensure cache flushes use dedicated low-latency comm stream and avoid synchronizing default streams. - Add microbenchmarks and regression tests for overlap behavior.

Checklist: - [x] Add new config knobs (runtime/nccl_stream_strategy) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Perf benchmarks + baseline comparisons - [x] Docs: perf tuning guide excerpt - [x] CI green (after one re-run)

Performance results (short): On internal perf harness with a 8xA100 (tensor-parallel depth 8) test workload we measured end-to-end token latency improvements of ~8-15% p50 and ~12-22% p95 depending on sequence length and KV-hit rate. NCCL utilization improved (fewer idle windows) and the overall token throughput increased by ~6-10% for batched steady-state workloads.

Related PRs: pr-41567-optimize-nccl-overlap-tp-collectives-and-kernel-scheduling.json, pr-40312-optimize-nccl-overlap-tp-kernel-scheduling.json

Notes: The runtime defaults were chosen conservatively to avoid regressions on less common topologies; the strategy is exposed as a config so customers on Dedicated/Private deployments can tune aggressively.

motivating_issue: Observed increased idle windows during NCCL all-reduce in production traces (ENG-2345); this PR addresses overlap to reduce idle time and tail latency.
